title: Systems Engineer (Cloud) - Swing Shift
description: JOB COMPETENCIES AWS depth: Advanced, practical command of AWS infrastructure services across compute, storage, networking and databases, sufficient to design a resilient deployment and to troubleshoot one that is failing. Multi-cloud consistency: Working command of Microsoft Azure alongside AWS, and the judgement to operate both to one standard rather than two divergent practices. Cloud identity command: Practical administration of AWS IAM and Microsoft Entra ID for infrastructure access, including federation, least-privilege role design, managed identities and elimination of long-lived credentials. Infrastructure as code: Treats infrastructure as code held in version control with peer review, state management and a promotion path, rather than as a set of console changes later documented. Automation mindset: Strong Terraform, Ansible, Python and Bash capability applied to provisioning, configuration, patching, remediation and reporting, treating repeated manual work as a defect. Container platform capability: Practical operation of Kubernetes and managed container services, including cluster lifecycle, RBAC, ingress, storage and autoscaling, and the boundary between platform and application. Observability judgement: Builds monitoring that detects failure early and tunes alerting so that what reaches an engineer is actionable rather than noise. Security orientation: Applies hardening baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation to cloud instances and cloud service configuration with the same discipline expected on premises. Resilience focus: Designs for availability zone and region failure where required and proves recovery by test rather than assuming it from a snapshot policy. Operational discipline: Runbook-driven execution, adherence to change control, and structured validation before and after every change, with a tested rollback path. Problem solving: Strong analytical skills with proven ability to identify root cause across compute, network, identity, storage, container and application layers rather than replacing an instance and moving on. Support capability: Supports cloud workloads serving users and business functions, works the agreed shift pattern, and hands over open work explicitly at shift boundaries. Collaboration: Works effectively with application teams, information security, the Wintel and Linux engineers and the M365 Platform Engineer and can hold a platform boundary without becoming a bottleneck. Documentation and knowledge transfer: Clear, maintainable runbooks, architecture documentation and code comments that reduce single-person dependency across shifts. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to explain a cloud outage, a cost variance or an access restriction to technical and business stakeholders in other regions.Accountability and autonomy: Owns the cloud estate end to end, prioritizes across a broad surface, and makes sound technical decisions with limited information and under incident pressure.Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a closely related field, or equivalent professional experience. (Required) 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering or administration, including 5+ years with substantial hands-on responsibility for production cloud infrastructure. (Required) Demonstrated hands-on administration of AWS at production scale, including EC2 and auto scaling, EBS and S3, VPC design, subnets, routing, security groups and peering or Transit Gateway, Route 53, ELB and ALB, and RDS. (Required) Demonstrated hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure services. (Required) Demonstrated hands-on administration of AWS IAM, including roles, policies, instance profiles, permission boundaries and least privilege design. (Required) Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Entra ID as it applies to cloud access, including groups, service principals, app registrations, managed identities and federation or single sign-on with AWS. (Required) Demonstrated experience building and maintaining Terraform configurations and modules in production, including remote state, environment separation and a promotion path. (Required) Demonstrated experience with Ansible for configuration management, hardening and patching of cloud instances. (Required) Strong Python and Bash scripting ability, including use of cloud SDKs and APIs such as boto3 for automation and reporting. (Required) Demonstrated experience operating Kubernetes in production, including a managed service such as EKS, ECS or AKS, covering cluster lifecycle, RBAC, ingress, storage and autoscaling. (Required) Demonstrated ownership of patching and operating system currency for cloud instances, including compliance reporting and exception governance against defined standards. (Required) Experience with cloud hardening baselines such as CIS, drift detection and remediation, and remediation of findings from a vulnerability management programme. (Required) Experience with encryption and secrets management in cloud, including KMS key policy and rotation, and a secrets or parameter store. (Required) Demonstrated experience with cloud monitoring and observability tooling, such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk or ELK, including alert tuning. (Required) Demonstrated experience managing cloud cost and consumption, including right-sizing, commitment planning, tagging governance and variance reporting. (Required) Experience with backup, replication and disaster recovery for cloud workloads, including cross-region or cross-account copies and validation by restore test. (Required) Experience with hybrid connectivity between cloud and on-premises, including VPN or Direct Connect and DNS resolution across environments. (Required) Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins or Azure DevOps for delivery of infrastructure change. (Preferred) Experience operating within a formal change-management process, including Change Advisory Board submission, rollback planning and post-implementation review. (Required) Experience working within a shift-based infrastructure team supporting a globally distributed estate, including structured handovers. (Required) Linux administration capability sufficient to build, harden and troubleshoot the instances hosting cloud workloads. (Required) Professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to coordinate with global infrastructure and application teams and to communicate with senior stakeholders. (Required) Certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional, or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator. (Preferred) Certification such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or a Kubernetes credential such as CKA. (Preferred)ITIL 4 Foundation, or equivalent demonstrated knowledge of incident, change and problem practice. (Preferred)An Equal Opportunity EmployerAll employment decisions are made without regard to unlawful considerations of race, sex, religion, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.Disclaimer: This job description indicates in general terms, the type and level of work performed as well as the typical responsibilities of employees in this classification and it may be changed by management at any time. Other duties may also apply. Nothing in this job description changes the at-will employment relationship existing between the Company and its employees.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
:
**HOOK**
is an e-bicycle conversion technology that transforms any analog bicycle into an smart electric bike within seconds, without tools, technical expertise, or permanent modification which you can use for outdoor and indoor workouts for fitness enthusiasts.

**Role Description:**

About the Job

Selected candidate’s day-to-day responsibilities include:

1.Work on IoT development, circuit & PCB design.

2.Work on the embedded design and programming of the system.

3.Work with the team on testing and validation of the product.

We are looking for Embedded Systems Engineer to join our team and work on designing and executing various projects related to embedded systems, IoT, and robotics. As an electronics engineer, you will be responsible for:

* Developing hardware and software solutions for different applications and domains mostly relating to the electric mobility industry.
* Testing, debugging, and troubleshooting the performance and functionality of electronic systems.
* Collaborating with other engineers, project managers, and clients to ensure the quality and timely delivery of the products
* Researching and staying updated on the latest technologies and trends in the field
* Documenting and presenting your work to internal and external stakeholders

* Be an electronics/electrical engineer in the related field
* Have experience in designing and implementing electronics systems - Proficiency in programming languages such as C, C++, Python, etc.
* Knowledge of various microcontrollers, sensors, actuators, communication protocols, etc.
* Experience in using tools such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, MATLAB, etc.
* Having worked on development of electric vehicles or were part of student project teams in college
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills
* A passion for innovation and learning new things

Microcontrollers (preferably ARM/ST32 microcontrollers), Circuit Design, Embedded Systems, Internet of Things, PCB Design (any program), Arduino.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please send your resume and a cover letter explaining why you are the best fit for this role to contact@hook.bike. We look forward to hearing from you soon.

**Perks:**

**Base pay+ ESOP options.**

title: System Admin – Veeam Backup L2
description:

 Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd. is a leading IT Infrastructure and Digital Transformation company with over 36 years of industry experience. Headquartered in Mumbai, Swan is a ₹1,749\+ Crore organization delivering IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Networking, Storage, Backup, and Managed Services to leading enterprise customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **System Administrator – Veeam Backup L2** 
 to manage enterprise backup, replication, recovery, and disaster recovery environments. The role requires strong hands\-on experience with Veeam Backup \& Replication and the ability to troubleshoot complex backup and recovery issues.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai – Client Site
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Contractual – Yearly Basis
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3–5 Years

 Monday to Saturday
   

  

**Shift:** 
 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
   

  

**2nd \& 4th Saturday:** 
 Remote Support
   

  

**Joining Requirement:** 
 Immediate Joiners to candidates with a
 **maximum notice period of 15 days** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Monitor daily backup, replication, and restore operations and ensure SLA compliance.
* Troubleshoot complex backup and replication issues escalated from L1\.
* Perform RCA for recurring backup incidents and implement preventive measures.
* Perform Instant VM Recovery, File\-Level Restore, and Application\-Aware Restore.

* Configure and monitor cloud backups for AWS, Azure, and Microsoft 365\.
* Perform DR drills, failover/failback testing, and backup validation.

* Follow ITIL\-based Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes.


**Required Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Veeam Backup \& Replication v11/v12 or later.
* Experience with Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 and Veeam ONE.
* Knowledge of plugin\-based and agent\-based backups.
* Experience with tape backup infrastructure and Disaster Recovery.
* Knowledge of cloud and object storage integration.
* Good understanding of Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\.
* Basic Linux Administration knowledge.
* Understanding of SAN/NAS, iSCSI/Fibre Channel, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, Firewall, and networking fundamentals.
* Basic PowerShell scripting knowledge is an added advantage.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work in shifts, including weekends/on\-call support when required.


 Qualification \& Certification
   

  

**Qualification:** 
 B.Sc. IT / BCA / B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent degree.
   

  

**Preferred Certifications**
* VMCE (Veeam Certified Engineer)
* VMware VCP
* Microsoft Certifications
* AWS / Azure Certifications


 What We Offer
   

  

* Exposure to enterprise\-scale backup and disaster recovery environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Veeam, cloud backup, storage, and virtualization technologies.
* Opportunity to work with leading enterprise customers.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.


 Ready to Join Us?
   

  

 If you have strong experience in
 **Veeam Backup, Recovery, Replication, and DR operations** 
 , we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Apply today and become a part of Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd.**

title: Communication Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Role: Communication Systems Engineer** 




  





**Location:** 
 Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai
 



  





**Job Category:** 
 Project Research Staff
 



  





**About the Project:** 




 A government\-funded initiative at IIT Bombay focusing on the development and demonstration of drone and allied technologies. This project aims to address various applications through the utilization of advanced technologies and critical infrastructure. We foster strong industry connections and collaborations to solve pertinent challenges and drive technological advancements. Comprehensive drone training and awareness programs will be provided to ensure proficiency and understanding among people. 
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking an experienced candidate to contribute to the design, development and implementation of advanced communication architectures for unmanned aerial systems. The role focuses on end\-to\-end UAV communication system design to enable reliable, low‑latency, and scalable data exchange across distributed aerial platforms and ground infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in both hardware and software, integrating communication protocols with algorithmic frameworks while ensuring compliance with industry standards. Collaboration across teams will be essential to drive innovative system improvements.
 



  





**Qualifications and Key Skills Required:** 




  





 • PhD with relevant experience, OR
 



 • M.Tech / M.E. or equivalent degree with relevant experience, OR
 



 • B.Tech / B.E. or equivalent degree with relevant experience.
 



 • In\-depth knowledge of wired and wireless communication protocols.
 



 • Strong understanding of RF systems, antenna theory, link budget calculation
 



 • Hands\-on experience RF testing using instruments such as spectrum analyzers and vector network analyzers.
 



 • Knowledge of EMI/EMC considerations and RF interference mitigation techniques for embedded and airborne platforms.
 



 • Experience with satellite communication (SATCOM) systems, including satellite modems, terminals and network architecture
 



 • Understanding of SATCOM protocols, link characteristics, latency and bandwidth optimization
 



 • Familiarity with RF simulation and antenna design/analysis tools (e.g., CST Studio Suite, HFSS, FEKO, or equivalent) is desirable.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities:** 




  





 • Design and develop robust communication systems for UAVs and their supporting infrastructure
 



 • Optimize MAC layer protocols for multi\-node wireless networks
 



 • Select and evaluate components including communication modules and development boards
 



 • Utilize simulation tools for testing and validating system behaviors under real\-world conditions
 



 • Analyze and optimize link throughput, latency, and signal robustness under varying conditions.
 



 • Ensure compliance with aviation regulations and safety standards
 



 • Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance the capabilities of UAV systems
 



 • Document design processes and test results, and provide technical reports
 



 • Any other work assigned as required

title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
description:
**TITLE: Senior IT Systems Engineer** 




**DEPARTMENT: Information Technology** 




**REPORTING TO: Director, Corporate IT Technical Services \& Support** 




**OFFICE LOCATION: Mumbai, India** 




**ROLE TYPE: Hybrid, Full\-time** 




  





 IPC is a global fintech company that puts people at the center of innovation. With a strong global footprint, we empower financial institutions and capital markets with advanced cloud\-based trading communications and managed connectivity solutions.
 



  





 Through our portfolio of communications and connectivity solutions, we focus on solving business challenges and adapting to regulatory changes in the fast\-paced global financial markets. This enables our clients to maintain consistent market access, a strong competitive advantage, and enhanced operational efficiency.
 



  





 Join a team that is dedicated to delivering groundbreaking products and making a significant impact on our clients' success.
 



  






 www.IPC.com
 




  





**Overview of the Team** 




  





 The IT Server Systems Engineer team is responsible for supporting the IT Server Infrastructure and Systems, which includes design, implement, manage, and optimization our server infrastructure support along with on\-going maintenance, and future development of company’s IT Server Services \& Cloud Infrastructure. This role requires occasional out of hours and weekend work.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 The IT Server Systems Engineer will be responsible for resolving escalated issues, diagnosing and addressing performance challenges, and supporting system maintenance and upgrade activities—occasionally scheduled over weekends. The role involves end to end project management, contributing as a technical resource on larger initiatives, and hands\-on server builds.
 



  




* **Server Administration** 
 : Install, configure, and maintain physical and virtual servers (Windows/Linux).
* **Monitoring \& Performance** 
 : Proactively monitor server performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure optimal system uptime.
* **Security** 
 : Implement and manage security measures, including patches, firewalls, and access controls, to safeguard data and systems.
* **Backup \& Recovery** 
 : Develop and maintain disaster recovery and backup strategies to ensure business continuity.
* **Automation \& Scripting** 
 : Create scripts and tools to automate server deployment, configuration, and maintenance.
* **Upgrades \& Migrations** 
 : Plan and execute server upgrades, migrations, and patch management.
* **Collaboration** 
 : Work closely with network engineers, Security engineers, DevOps, and IT support teams to deliver a stable and scalable environment.
* **Documentation** 
 : Maintain detailed documentation of server infrastructure, configurations, and procedures.



  





**Essential Skills and Experience to be Successful in this Role:** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent (7\+ years) related work experience.
* Proven experience as a Server Engineer, Systems Administrator, or similar role.
* Strong knowledge and experience in hybrid infrastructure environments:
* Windows and Linux systems.
* Virtualization technologies (VMware, or Hyper\-V).
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and GCP), including deployment, configuration, and management of cloud resources such as Azure AD, virtual networks, storage solutions, and security services.
* Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure, Proficiency in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for scripting and automation.
* Experience with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and Group Policy.
* Hands\-on experience administering hybrid identity across on\-prem Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including federation and conditional access with multi\-cloud IAM (AWS IAM, GCP IAM), Office 365, and Microsoft Exchange.
* Skilled in implementing and managing multi\-factor authentication (MFA) for secure access.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure\-as\-Code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation) for provisioning and managing resources across multi\-cloud environments.
* Hands\-on experience with security engineering tasks such as vulnerability assessment, remediation tracking, and endpoint/EDR tooling, in addition to general system security controls.
* Experience supporting or coordinating infrastructure across multiple regions/time zones (e.g., APAC, EMEA, Americas) in a follow\-the\-sun or globally distributed support model.
* Experience providing technical mentorship or guidance to junior engineers on server, cloud, and automation initiatives.
* Understanding of SSL certificate managements and encryption.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and documentation.
* Ability to create and maintain strong working relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to remain composed under pressure while maintaining a constructive and positive mindset.



  





**Desired Skills and Experience:** 




  




* Solid understanding of scalable security infrastructures, with practical knowledge of tools for email filtering, vulnerability assessment, and proactive threat prevention.
* Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Knowledge of monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds, or equivalent).
* Understanding of ITIL processes and best practices.
* Familiarity with backup and recovery platforms such as Veeam or Commvault.
* Familiarity with enterprise storage platforms such as PowerStore or EMC.
* Certifications such as MCSE, RHCE, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, or VMware VCP.



  





**What’s in It for You?** 




  





 At IPC, your compensation is only part of the package. We are committed to investing in a range of programs and initiatives to improve the overall experience of our employees.
 



  





 In addition to a collaborative, high\-performing team environment, we’re pleased to offer benefits including:
 



  




* Health Insurance Plan
* Annual Health Check Benefit
* Group Term Life Insurance Plan
* Flexible PTO plus Public Holidays
* Additional Time off for Charity Work and Volunteering
* Global Tuition Reimbursement
* Global Certification Bonus Program
* Access to our E\-Learning Platform – IPC University \& LinkedIn Learning
* Structured Onboarding Program and Peer Mentor Support
* Enhanced Parental Leave
* Global Wellness Program
* Employee Referral Program



  





 Further information about your benefits will be provided during your onboarding process.
 



  





**Additional Information:** 




  





 At IPC, we believe that hybrid working creates an inclusive, flexible environment where employees can perform at their best, and teams can collaborate, innovate, and celebrate successes together. We spend around 60% of our time in the office and around 40% of our time working remotely. Some employees may be required to work from the office or client sites more than 60% of the time, if required by their role and/or client needs.
 



  





 Your precise work schedule will be determined by you and your Line Manager before commencement of employment with IPC.
 



 You can explore more about our culture, offerings and commitment on
 
 www.ipc.com/careers/
 
 and
 
 www.ipc.com/about\-us/about\-ipc/
 
 .
 



  





**IPC’s Work Culture:** 




  





 The IPC work culture is one that fosters inclusion, prioritizes innovation, and maximizes potential. We are a global ecosystem, full of diverse people that together made IPC what it is today.
 



  





 Our strength as an organization is the sum of our different backgrounds, perspectives, skills and geographies; supported by an ironclad commitment to constructive dialogue and open\-mindedness.
 



 We live and breathe our commitment to innovation by embracing bold ideas, seizing new opportunities and striving for excellence. Our people have continued to deliver ground\-breaking solutions to our clients for over 50 years.

title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre-Sales)
description:

**What You’ll Do**
